pull.title: fix(runtime): include the production Memories intent adapter
pull.body:
Ordinary DomainService publishing omits the owner intent adapter, and its catalog registration scans only the declarations assembly. Add the adapter to the normal owner project graph and pass its actual factory assembly to SDK catalog registration. The existing nonpublishing compatibility profile remains available.

The preparation dependency selects genuine Builds 4.44.4 while preserving the current newer EventStore source dependency. Ordinary Release output consumes genuine public SDK 4.1.0 packages.

Validation: the compiled discovery regression fails before the fix and passes afterward; all 13 DomainService cases and three existing catalog cases pass. The final ordinary filesystem publish includes the adapter and authentic SDK bodies. Public SDK package signatures, existing profile controls and the Builds preparation fixtures were checked locally. All owner CI and normal protected publication gates remain required. Local artifacts are private development evidence and grant no hosted native or candidate acceptance.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes the DomainService dependency graph and development catalog registration for the authenticated command/replay host, which affects routing/idempotency at runtime and publish output; scope is limited to wiring an existing adapter assembly rather than new domain logic.
> 
> **Overview**
> **Ordinary DomainService builds were shipping without the owner intent adapter**, so runtime catalog registration only scanned declarations and could not load the compiled idempotency adapters.
> 
> The fix **pulls `Hexalith.Memories.EventStoreExtensions` into the normal project graph** (source reference for native builds; package reference unchanged for the published hosted-test profile) and **registers the `MemoriesCatalogAdapters` assembly** alongside declarations in `AddEventStoreDevelopmentDomainCatalog`.
> 
> A new **`ProductionCatalogAdapterTests`** regression asserts the host’s dependency closure resolves the adapter factory, yields six `DeclaredIdempotencyIntentAdapter<>` instances aligned with `MemoriesCatalogDeclarations`, and matches compiled route digests. **Published-host profile tooling** now expects `EventStoreExtensions` on DomainService. **Builds publication qualification** pins were bumped to `5fa2b97c8b22047c2c33e2c9f7017fd5d604c9ef`.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 23f7231ac1329e681d0b2b4bba876e62b3bb095b. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
